ruleDefinitions.name: AWL Bypass with Winrm.vbs and Malicious WsmPty.xsl/WsmTxt.xsl
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of attacker-controlled WsmPty.xsl or WsmTxt.xsl via winrm.vbs and copied cscript.exe (can be renamed)

sequences.query: process_command_line = RGX(".*winrm.*") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*format\\:pretty.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*format\\:\\"pretty\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*format\\:\\"text\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*format\\:text.*")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\"))))
